rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the previously mentioned reality
absolutive expressing prior cognition leading to the result
compound describing the concealed essential reality as object of knowing
state of omniscience arising as the result
verb expressing the emergence of omniscience

items.question: What result follows from knowing the hidden true nature?
premises: The hidden true nature can be known.
Knowing that hidden true nature produces a specific result.
items.inference: Knowing the hidden true nature gives rise to all-knowingness.
uncertainties: The gender of taṃ is taken as masculine in agreement with an implied referent, though the form is ambiguous in isolation.
items.plain_english: Having known that hidden true nature, omniscience arises.
